answer_1.quote: We propose employing text-to-table as a new way of information extraction (IE), which extracts information of interest from the input text and summarizes the extracted information in tables.
answer_1.outputs: tables summarizing content from input texts

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of a method based on (1) the number of correct headers and (2) the number of correct non-header cells. We adopt the F1 score as the evaluation measure.
